title: APS6 Markets/Data Analyst
text: APS6 Markets/Data Analyst at face2face Recruitment (ACT, ; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Contract until 30 June 2018 Possible extension until 21 December 2018 Must have a current Baseline security clearance Excellent opportunity for an experienced APS6 Markets/Data Analyst to join a Federal Government department. Duties: Researching, analysing and developing innovative modelling approaches to understand the current and potential future state of the markets and/or proactively liaise, communicate, engage and collaborate with clients and stakeholders to gain a range of market perspectives. Lead and take ownership for the delivery of a range of projects on behalf of the team. Provide detailed advice and reporting on energy and carbon market issues and drivers to senior executives within the agency. Represent the department at internal and external forums, meetings and presentations. Supervise and develop team members and build team capacity through coaching, performance feedback and encouraging career development. Essential requirements of the position include: Tertiary qualifications in finance/economics/mathematics and/or focus in markets/commerce. Demonstrated ability to develop ongoing relationships with colleagues and industry stakeholders, Good data analysis skills, including intermediate to advanced Excel knowledge, Ability to take responsibility for and solve complex problems, Well-developed written and verbal communication skills, The ability to develop a sound understanding of environmental and/or energy markets and the ability to interpret related policy and legislation. If you are interested in applying for this position,please submit your application via the button below.
